prepare:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/lib -p 'test_prepare_android_release.py' -v
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./app/package.json').version")
python3 scripts/lib/prepare_android_release.py \
  --outputs app/src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/catstep-android-release" \
  --version "$VERSION"
upload:
set -euo pipefail
gh release view "${{ github.ref_name }}" || gh release create "${{ github.ref_name }}" --draft --title "猫步 MD (Catstep MD) ${{ github.ref_name }}" --notes "Auto-built by GitHub Actions"
python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/catstep-android-release/manifest.json" "${{ github.ref_name }}" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
from scripts.lib.prepare_android_release import verified_prepared_paths

# Validate the complete explicit manifest before the first upload.
paths = verified_prepared_paths(Path(sys.argv[1]))
for path in paths:
    subprocess.run(['gh', 'release', 'upload', sys.argv[2], str(path), '--clobber'], check=True)
PY
